name: Soft Graphite
summary: Closest to the selected design; graphite, pearl, slate and ember Rokys
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise style-transfer and avatar compositing.
INPUT 1: the user's SELECTED Graphite & Amber interface, EDIT TARGET. It shows the actual Hermes Studio Bots screen above the actual Echo chat below. The user LIKES this design and asks for a few closely related options.
INPUT 2: a newly generated ROKY AVATAR FAMILY sheet, ASSET/IDENTITY REFERENCE. It contains eight numbered original Roki color/silhouette/expression variants: 01 Basalt (dark graphite), 02 Pearl (white), 03 Ember (orange/happy eyes), 04 Cobalt (blue), 05 Slate (blue-gray), 06 Copper (copper-orange), 07 Jade (green/curious eyes), 08 Titanium (silver/happy eyes).
PRIMARY TASK: preserve the selected interface, refine only the specific nearby material/palette details below, and replace the repeated default Roki portraits with FOUR DIFFERENT Rokys according to the exact assignments below. The main visible change must include distinct per-bot avatar identities. Do not render the same gray Roki in every row again.
OUTPUT: preserve the TALL PORTRAIT 2:3 aspect ratio, approximately 1024 x 1536. Two large screenshots stacked exactly as Input 1: Bots above, Echo chat below. No extra marketing poster, character strip, avatar catalogue, photos, perspective or decorative illustration. Small study number/name outside the interface is optional. Keep the software readable.
LOCK THE PRODUCT: same left sidebar width, native engine strip with "This Mac" and "Home server", same navigation Dashboard/Bots/Team rooms/Routines/Settings, same three-column bot card grid with Echo in the next row, same filter/New bot actions, same card proportions, typography and spacing. In chat keep the existing left team roster, central welcome and composer, right teammate inspector and actual controls. Preserve the bot names and roles: Atlas / Chief of staff, Nova / Creative partner, Scout / Research analyst, Echo / Writing partner. Do not rename bots to the avatar material names. Do not invent activity or task results.
LOCK THE SELECTED IDENTITY: white reading surfaces, clean light glass cards, dark graphite pills and text, amber/orange primary actions, restrained warm corner light. Familiar native-like sans typography at existing sizes. No beige/cream tint over the page, no purple/lavender backgrounds, no blue-primary redesign, no giant display type or rearranged screens.
AVATAR REPLACEMENT RULES: copy the assigned variant's material COLOR, faceted body silhouette and eye expression consistently from Input 2. Each bot must match itself in EVERY location: sidebar in both screenshots, bot card, header, inspector, teammate mini-list, and main welcome where relevant. Interface avatars use HEAD-ONLY portraits cropped from the selected variant, no legs or shoes inside those compact tiles. Use a neutral translucent white frame, not a colored badge. In Echo's welcome use the FULL-BODY assigned Echo variant with its matching sneakers and expression at the SAME RESTRAINED SCALE as Input 1. Keep rock facets, recessed face, original orange side insert and sneaker construction. No hats, props, animals, plants, horns, unrelated robots, mouths/teeth, hostile angled eyes or excessive eye glow. These are clearly Roki family members, not new species.
Do not merely paste the second reference sheet into the interface. Actually place the specified different avatars into the working interface.
STUDY 01 / SOFT GRAPHITE.
UI: closest to the selected Graphite & Amber. Keep the exact pure-white background and existing small orange corner light. Slightly soften card shadows, keep fine clear-white glass edges, dark graphite active filter/nav, vivid orange primary actions with the original amber-to-orange gradient. No overall background recolor.
EXACT AVATAR ASSIGNMENTS:
Atlas = 01 BASALT, broad dark graphite with relaxed upright eyes.
Nova = 02 PEARL, pure-white stone with a taller crown and dark face.
Scout = 05 SLATE, light blue-gray, broad softer facets and open eyes.
Echo = 03 EMBER, vivid orange compact stone with cheerful happy eye arcs.
Echo's large chat welcome must be the ORANGE EMBER full-body figure, not the original gray default. All four are visibly distinct in both sidebar and cards.
